savings.reason: Sections 1-4 govern only the Board, which terminates under section 4(b). No independent continuing directive or express savings appears in the original or EO13138. The travel-expense authorization is incident to intermittent Board service and does not perpetuate the Board or its advisory/support duties. Any accrued reimbursement liability arises under the referenced general law, rather than a live independent command of this order.

research_rationale: The complete original establishes and administers only the President’s Advisory Board on Race. Section 4(b) expressly terminates the Board on September 30, 1998 unless the President extends it before that date. All original establishment, membership, advisory, coordination, support, travel, and FACA-delegation commands depend on that Board; no independent continuing command appears. No extension is identified in the dossier’s bounded later-source searches, and EO13138 section 3(e) expressly treats the Board as already terminated with its work completed. Therefore September 30, 1998 is the first end, with EO13138 revocation a later event effective September 30, 1999 under its section 9. The possibility of an unidentified unpublished extension alone supplies no affirmative contrary lead. No dossier conflicts precede acceptance of the search IDs. OFR catalog and saved-text searches and the eCFR search through the legal cutoff are adequate bounded counterevidence searches for this post-1937 NO order; the US Code search explicitly stops at October 9, 2026 and is supplementary only, not a current affirmative predicate.
